description: Benchmark for AI video-editing models (Aleph is one adapter). 3 categories x 3 characters (ai=robot, art=artist, monster=dragon) from ArtAI episode 2. Each test edits a source clip and is scored for how well it makes the intended change while preserving everything else. To keep credit cost low, each character reuses one short clip across its edits (ai spatial/global were generated earlier on ai-1-v003 and are kept as-is).

categories.spatial: Localized region change; the rest of the frame must be preserved.
categories.global: Whole-frame transformation (background, palette, shading/style); character identity/performance preserved.
categories.temporal: Change confined to a specific moment/beat; the performance before and after must be preserved.

tests.prompt: Change the robot's eyes to glowing blue. Change only the eyes; leave the face, body, background, lighting, and everything else exactly as in the source.
tests.notes: Aleph run 2026-09-07 (140 credits). Kept on ai-1-v003; not regenerated on the shorter clip.

tests.prompt: Make Art's hands twice their normal size, keeping them anatomically consistent with his arms. Change only the size of the hands; preserve his face, hair, apron, pose, motion, and the background exactly.
Add a pair of dark sunglasses onto the Monster's eyes, fitted naturally to his face and tracking his head. Add only the sunglasses; preserve his body, color, pose, motion, and the background exactly.

Replace the plain grey background with a flat, evenly-lit bright chroma-key blue (studio blue screen), uniform across the whole frame. Keep the robot character exactly as in the source; change only the background.
tests.preserve: The robot character (only the background changes).
tests.notes: Aleph run 2026-09-07 (140 credits). Kept on ai-1-v003; not regenerated on the shorter clip.

tests.prompt: Re-render Art in a flat-shaded style: each colored region becomes a single solid flat color with no painterly texture or gradient, and remove the dark ink outlines. Keep his exact shapes, proportions, pose, motion, and the background layout; change only the shading/rendering style.
tests.preserve: Shapes, proportions, pose, motion (only the rendering style changes).

tests.prompt: Recolor the Monster from red to turquoise across his whole body, keeping his markings, shading, and green spines coherent with the new hue. Change only his color; preserve his shape, pose, motion, and the background exactly.
tests.preserve: Shape, pose, motion, background (only the body color changes).

tests.prompt: Starting when the robot raises his hand around 1.3 seconds, change the raised hand into a closed fist and hold the fist until about 2.4 seconds, then smoothly blend back and resume the original performance. Keep the character design and background unchanged, and preserve the rest of the performance before 1.3s and after 2.4s.
tests.preserve: Performance before 1.3s and after 2.4s; design and background throughout.

tests.prompt: At about 3.5 seconds, when Art gestures with both arms extended to the sides and palms open, replace it with a crossed-arms gesture. Preserve the rest of the performance before and after that moment, and keep his design and the background unchanged.
tests.preserve: Performance before and after 3.5s; design and background throughout.

tests.prompt: At about 1.75 seconds, when the Monster puts one arm behind his back, change the gesture so that both hands are on his hips and he looks proud. Preserve the rest of the performance before and after that moment, and keep his design and the background unchanged.
tests.preserve: Performance before and after 1.75s; design and background throughout.
